title: Rabbi Joey Soffer: Mesilat Yesharim class # 20

chapters.title: Introduction to Tahara and improper motives
chapters.about: purity, negative thoughts, mitzvos for wrong reasons

chapters.title: Categories of doing mitzvos for the wrong reasons
chapters.about: worst category, personal gain, honor, money, Yerushalmi Berachos

chapters.title: Doing mitzvos for the reward
chapters.about: reward of mitzvah, lo lishmah, evolving to lishmah

chapters.title: Mixture of motives in pure mitzvos
chapters.about: isur, mixed intentions, praise of people, self-aggrandizement

chapters.title: The analogy of fine flour on the mizbeach
chapters.about: flower offering, solet, Beit HaMikdash, shamayim, blemishes

chapters.title: Human limitations and striving for lishmah
chapters.about: materialistic humans, goal to get there, relationship with Hashem

chapters.title: How to acquire Tahara
chapters.about: worth of worldly pleasures, physical existence, onus, purity of thought

chapters.title: Preparation before performing a mitzvah
chapters.about: not rushing into mitzvah, preparation in advance, meditation before prayer

chapters.title: Things that cause the loss of Tahara
chapters.about: lack of thinking, running after honor, spoiling tefillah, illicit relations in the mind

summary: Rabbi Soffer continues teaching chapter 16 of Mesilas Yesharim, focusing on the attribute of Tahara (purity) and how to acquire it in thought and action. He discusses doing mitzvos for the wrong reasons, the danger of mixing ulterior motives like seeking praise into pure service, and practical ways to purify one's intentions.
questions: What are the categories of doing a mitzvah for the wrong reasons?
How does a mixture of praise affect an otherwise pure mitzvah?
Why is preparing your mind before prayer important for Tahara?
How can a person overcome materialistic pleasures in this world?
